headline: Capital India Finance appoints new Company Secretary
hook: Leadership change at Capital India Finance
summary: Capital India Finance Limited has officially notified the NSE regarding the appointment of a new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. This role is responsible for ensuring the company adheres to regulatory and legal standards. Such changes are standard corporate governance procedures for listed entities.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative change with no immediate impact on stock performance.

headline: Capital India Finance reports board meeting outcomes
hook: Capital India Finance board meeting concludes
summary: Capital India Finance Limited held a board meeting on October 5, 2026. The company formally notified the NSE regarding the proceedings of this meeting. No specific financial results or major corporate actions were disclosed in the initial filing.
